Elena (CSM): Heads-up — QuantumFlux flagged by monitoring. /generate DAU down ~57% over 6d; seats 51 -> 19. Renewal ~4 weeks. Dash: https://redwood.app/metrics/quantumflux

Ravi (CS Ops): Confirmed. Generation volume down, embeddings steady. p95 up 700ms -> 1.6s. No 5xxs. Telemetry shows fewer concurrent connections from their IPs.

Marco (AE): Who's the champion? Any procurement notes or competitor activity?

Elena (CSM): Champion Noor moved teams last sprint. New contact is infra lead Mateo; they replied theyre trialing a competitor POC last week. CFO asked for cost breakdown yesterday.

Jin (Product): We launched a cost-focused variant ~10 days ago that reduces default max_tokens and applies early-stop for <high_cost> routes. If routed, that matches reports of abrupt truncation. I'll check routing snapshot for account id qf-prod between 1758900000-1759000000.

Tess (Support): Ticket Q-1107 opened. Mateo sent sample payload: {"model":"redwood-gen-2","prompt":"Draft executive summary...","max_tokens":110,"client_batch":1}. He notes outputs cut mid-sentence.

Marco (AE): Given churn + competitor POC + procurement asks, we should prioritize a stabilization plan. Proposal: 21-day Dedicated preview with throughput credits + a short SLA. Legal fast-SOW possible?

Elena (CSM): Customer also mentioned increased UI latency. Ravi, can you reproduce truncation with their sample?

Ravi (CS Ops): Will run prompt-eval now. Also checking SDK: their reported client_version is 2.0.0 which changed backoff semantics earlier this year. Might amplify perceived latency if concurrency is limited.

Jin (Product): Actionable plan: 1) Marco: exec intro + pilot offer by EOD; 2) Ravi: repro + SDK telemetry check, ETA 3pm; 3) Jin: confirm routing and prepare a 10% A/B revert to previous variant if customer approves, ETA tomorrow 9:30am PT; 4) Tess: own ticket updates and collect 3 more payload examples.

NotifyBot: Scheduled healthcheck for QuantumFlux (routing + truncation trace) — results attach to Q-1107 in ~20m.

Marco (AE): I'll loop in finance/legal now for a 21-day credit pilot. If they allow a temp bump in concurrency we can A/B test routing immediately.

Elena (CSM): Assigning owners. Keep updates short. If we can show full-output rate improvement with a revert test, that strengthens the renewal ask. :rocket:
